question: Does the immutable deterministic current-main projection support one complete finite C5 semantic grammar envelope that survives every preserved closure and can be enumerated and ordered without model-selected instantiated candidates?
decision: The accountable owner admits one envelope only when the independent read-only report satisfies every completeness, closure, finiteness, ordering and context gate; otherwise record futility or inconclusive exactly as frozen.

requiredFields: new semantic producer or consumer edge
reportContract.machineReadableBlock: One valid JSON object containing only dimension names, finite level arrays, constraints and source/closure evidence references. It must contain no instantiated Cartesian row, selected card/content ID, selected numeric candidate or efficacy assertion.
reportContract.completenessTable: Map every required field to exact projection evidence and exact closure survival evidence.
reportContract.counterevidence: State the strongest source or closure reason the envelope may still fail at a later identity/capacity gate.

lexicographicComplexityOrdering: persistent or save fields, required to equal zero
new global, private-hand or online policy selectors, required to equal zero
canonical UTF-8 family and level IDs
closureRules: At least one producer or consumer is a genuinely new combat-local semantic transition rather than an existing transition, relation/history predicate, arithmetic residual, identity/replay transform or storage change.
Changing only carrier, name, card/target subset, threshold, duration, expiry or payoff magnitude is an alias of a preserved closure.
Scoreline and Afterimage remain separate causal factors and cannot be the new producer or consumer.
No Ward-spend threshold, producer, payoff, cohort, policy, method, import, cache or schema rescue is permitted.
No global/private-hand selector, persistence, relic/acquisition commitment, save/internal-ID change, RNG change or protected identity is permitted before mechanism admission.
successRule: Exactly one report envelope defines every required field with non-empty finite levels, cites only the frozen inputs, survives every closure rule, exposes deterministic constrained enumeration, and can be ordered by the frozen lexicographic tuple without the report selecting an instantiated candidate.
futilityRule: The bounded inputs prove that no complete finite envelope can satisfy all required fields and closure rules. Close only this grammar universe and continue with the next evidence-backed structural method inside #421.
inconclusiveRule: Any input/hash mismatch, forbidden source access, context/output ceiling breach, missing field, non-finite level, ambiguous enumeration, instantiated candidate selection or unresolved closure mapping yields no grammar conclusion. With correction cap zero, do not repair or rerun this protocol.
afterSuccess: The owner performs one consolidation into a machine-readable grammar and one Markdown evidence note, then deterministic code validates and enumerates the complete candidate set before any prototype or simulator row. The owner does not alter the reported semantic dimensions or levels during consolidation.
nonGoals: Do not read current-main source outside the immutable projection.
Do not instantiate, rank or select a candidate, card, relic, content ID or numeric payoff.
Do not prototype, run Godot or simulator rows, inspect cache/ledger outcomes, add ML/RL, use protected identities, mutate product truth, open a PR, run Actions or create a successor ticket.
